3D vehicle models for PERKAKAS Trip Replay
============================================

- mobil.glb, kart.glb, van.glb, taksi.glb  — Kenney Car Kit v3.1 (CC0 1.0)
  https://kenney.nl/assets/car-kit
- bus.glb  — "Schoolbus" by Poly by Google (CC-BY 3.0)
  via https://poly.pizza/m/8xacyNqdJ3t
- motor.glb — "Motorcycle" by Poly by Google (CC-BY 3.0)
  via https://poly.pizza/m/5_MTCnqfUTr
- pesawat.glb — "Airplane" by Poly by Google (CC-BY 3.0)
  via https://poly.pizza/m/8VysVKMXN2J

CC-BY credits are shown in the Trip Replay panel UI.
